flow: approved Offer and four-part Dossier acceptance
bearer-protected vendor-order evidence transition to PRODUCTION_IN_PROGRESS
idempotent immediate vendor-action notification after first Stripe confirmation
Human receipt-photo, same-process and eight-score review
approved proof registration only after ACCEPT

verified.orderEvidenceCandidate: PASS — vendor invoice, Stripe settlement and fulfillment files are hashed; order and tracking references are domain-separated HMACs
verified.economicsActuals: PASS — current real fulfilled orders remain 0; synthetic validator output is not counted as business evidence

privacy: The review candidate uses a one-way derived candidate id plus Edition, fulfillment time and evidence hash. No customer name, email, address, tracking number or payment identifier is exposed in daily operations.
evidenceBoundary: A fulfilled order creates only a proof-review candidate. It is never counted as a Human-approved physical proof until the received object is reviewed and an explicit ACCEPT token is registered.
